title: Implant paper rejected by Journal of Scientific Exploration

tellings.quote: Yeah, he he and I tried to write a paper and we tried to publish it in the Journal of Scientific Exploration

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who has analysed small objects said to be alien implants taken from people's bodies, says he and Roger Leir, a doctor who removed such objects, wrote a paper and tried to publish it in the Journal of Scientific Exploration, a journal for studies on unusual subjects, and it was rejected. Colbern tells it as something he lived through, as an example of how hard it was to get the work taken seriously.
